newsitem.title: USA: ILEX, Lilly, Physician Reliance in pact.
newsitem.headline: ILEX, Lilly, Physician Reliance in pact.

text.p: Drug development firm ILEX Oncology Inc said on Thursday it and Physician Reliance Network, an oncology practice management company, entered a five-year development pact with Eli Lilly and Co to develop two anticancer compounds.

"Our unique alliance...enables us to more effectively deal with clinical trials design issues, patient accrual and data management," Richard Love, president and chief executive of ILEX Oncology, said.
The Cancer Therapy and Research Center Research Foundation would conduct preclinical and clinical research, it said.

Under the deal, ILEX would serve as the contract research organization for Lilly, managing the clinical development of both compounds. Physician Reliance and Cancer Therapy would participate in clinical trial design and serve as trial sites.
Other financial terms were not disclosed.
